claims.content: To report Electronic Warfare product information, including EW Fixes, Areas of Probability (AOP), and Lines of Bearing (LOB), while retaining reporting responsibility for the originated data.

goal.raw_text: To report Electronic Warfare product information, including EW Fixes, Areas of Probability (AOP), and Lines of Bearing (LOB), while retaining reporting responsibility for the originated data.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU must have generated or received EW product information (such as an EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report) that it intends to publish.

If the C2 JU is initiating a new J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report, it must assign a Track Number (TN) not known to be in use on the interface, even if believed to concern the same emitter currently reported by another unit — unless it is originating a report on a fix/AOP/LOB already reported by itself or received via J14.0 message from another unit.

For reporting an Area of Probability (AOP), the C2 JU must have organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination thereof to define an area with 95% probability (2 sigma) of emitter location.

If reporting a bearing origin for an EW LOB, the C2 JU must determine whether the origin is its own unit, another existing IU/track/point, or a designated position, and set corresponding fields accordingly (Bearing Origin field, Origin TN field, and J3.7C2 word).
The C2 JU must retain reporting responsibility for any J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report it originates; it is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit’s such report.
The C2 JU originates a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report and retains reporting responsibility for it.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU originates a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report and retains reporting responsibility for it.

claims.content: The C2 JU determines which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG, either manually or through automatic association with predetermined reporting criteria.
If reporting a Line of Bearing (LOB), the C2 JU uses the J3.7 EW Product Information Message and sets the Fix or Bearing Descriptor (FIX BRG) field in the J3.7I word as required.
If reporting an Area of Probability (AOP), the C2 JU transmits using a J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum, with the FIX BRG field set to value 1 in the J3.7I word.

For AOP reporting, the J3.7I word contains the time the AOP was valid and the J3.7C2 word defines the AOP; if resulting from previously reported LOBs, it shall be assigned a new TN not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs.

If reporting bearing origin for an EW LOB, the C2 JU sets the Bearing Origin field and Origin TN field according to whether the origin is its own unit, another existing IU/track/point, or a designated position, and transmits the J3.7C2 word containing latitude and longitude of the bearing origin.
The C2 JU retains reporting responsibility for the originated J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report; it is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit’s such report.

If initiating a new J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report, the C2 JU assigns a TN not known to be in use on the interface — unless originating a report on a fix/AOP/LOB already reported by itself or received via J14.0 message from another unit, in which case it assigns the same TN referenced in the J3.7 message contained in the J14.0 message.

Upon termination of EW product information (when no longer valid or update requirements not met), the C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message if it had been reporting on the interface; remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.

If a C2 JU attempts to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report, this is illegal and constitutes an exception condition — the system must reject such assumption of responsibility.

If a C2 JU initiates a new J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report using a Track Number (TN) already known to be in use on the interface (and not covered by the J14.0 message exception), this violates protocol — the system must flag or reject the duplicate TN assignment.

If an AOP is generated from previously reported LOBs but is assigned one of the original LOBs’ TNs instead of a new TN, this violates the rule that ‘an AOP resulting from previously reported LOBs shall be assigned a new TN’ — the system must enforce TN reassignment.

If an AOP results from two or more previously reported fixes of differing TNs but is assigned one of those existing TNs instead of a new TN, this violates the rule requiring a new TN — the system must detect and prevent this misassignment.

If a fix is changed to an AOP but the system fails to retain the previously reported fix’s TN for the new AOP (as required when changing fix to AOP), this constitutes an exception — the system must ensure TN continuity in this specific transition.
The C2 JU retains reporting responsibility for the J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report it originated.
If an AOP was reported resulting from previously reported LOBs, a new Track Number (TN) not assigned to any of the original LOBs has been assigned to the AOP.
If an AOP resulted from two or more previously reported fixes of differing TNs, a new TN not one of the TNs assigned to the fixes has been assigned to the AOP.
If a fix was changed to an AOP, the TN of the previously reported fix is retained and used for all subsequent updates of the AOP.

If bearing origin was reported for an EW LOB, the Bearing Origin field, Origin TN field, and J3.7C2 word have been transmitted according to whether the origin was own unit, another existing IU/track/point, or designated position.

Upon termination of EW product information transmission, if the C2 JU had been reporting on the interface, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message has been transmitted; remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
